author: New China TV
description: Escorted across the sky by fighter jets and received in silence, flags, and salutes, 12 Chinese People's Volunteers martyrs have finally come home. A Y-20B transport aircraft carried their remains from South Korea to Shenyang, where over 1,800 people gathered in solemn tribute. Part of a decade-long mission that has returned more than 1,000 fallen soldiers, the repatriation blends military precision with national remembrance, bringing long-awaited closure to families and reigniting the memory of a war that cost hundreds of thousands of lives.
title: Remains of 12 Chinese martyrs in Korean War returned to homeland from ROK

author: New China TV
description: What is education really for? In 1180, Zhu Xi wrote down his answer at Bailudong Academy in east China's Jiangxi Province. Not for exams. Not for a job. Education, he thought, is about how to be a good person. His words in the Bailudong Academy Directives spread across East Asia and are still upheld as mottos in some schools in South Korea and Japan today.
title: Academy Answers | What is education really for?
